title: The Sins of the Father
logline: A young heir inherits their family's estate, only to discover it comes with a massive, unpayable debt to a local crime syndicate that immediately comes to collect.

roles.description: Sheltered, terrified, suddenly responsible for debts they didn't incur.
Served the family for decades; knows where all the bodies are buried.
Polite, terrifying, views the young heir as an easy mark to seize the estate.
A pack of heavily armed syndicate debt collectors.
A decaying, opulent orbital manor that costs a fortune to maintain.
The remnants of a once-powerful aristocratic family.
The shadow economy that actually runs the local sector.

public_situation: The patriarch of a local {role:noble_house} has died, and the young heir is struggling to keep the family estate operational.
private_truth: The patriarch funded his lavish lifestyle by borrowing heavily from the {role:crime_syndicate}. The debt is due, and the collateral is the estate itself.

beats.public_change: Syndicate ships begin openly blockading the family estate.

missions.reason: Needs a hired gun to break the blockade and recover a seized transport carrying the family's only liquid assets.
missions.private_fact: The heir has no idea how deep the debt goes, assuming this is a simple shakedown.

missions.reason: Frantically hires the pilot to mine and deliver raw cuprite so the estate can process it into tradeable ingots to pay the interest for just one more month.
missions.private_fact: The retainer knows the estate is doomed but is trying to buy enough time to smuggle the heir out of the system.

beats.public_change: The syndicate boss arrives personally to claim the estate.

missions.reason: The heir orders the pilot to destroy the boss's escort ship to force them to back down.
missions.private_fact: The heir plans to self-destruct the estate rather than surrender it if this fails.

beats.public_change: The blockade breaks, but the syndicate lawyers present the final claim.

missions.reason: Begs the pilot to scan the patriarch's private physical archives for the original loan documents to find a legal loophole.
missions.private_fact: The scans reveal the original loan was signed by the retainer, not the patriarch. The retainer is legally liable for the debt, not the heir.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the proof to the heir.
resolutions.summary: The heir legally shifts the debt to the loyal retainer. The syndicate forces the retainer into an indentured labour contract, and the heir keeps the estate.

consequences.public_summary: The young noble threw their oldest servant to the wolves to keep their fancy house.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the proof or takes the syndicate offer.
resolutions.summary: Without the loophole, the syndicate seizes the estate. The heir flees into poverty, and the noble house is destroyed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the documents to the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate quietly buries the loophole and takes the estate, but pays the pilot handsomely. The retainer flees into exile.

loose_threads.detail: The patriarch's medical records show he died of a rare synthetic poison, not natural heart failure.
A syndicate enforcer mentions the family creditor knew the patriarch was dead three days before it was publicly announced.

radio_hooks: Creditors surround {role:family_estate} following patriarch's sudden passing.
{role:noble_house} denies rumors of insolvency, claims 'minor liquidity dispute'.

voice_direction.heir_apparent: Trembling pitch, overcompensating with volume. Clearly out of their depth.
voice_direction.loyal_retainer: Stoic, tired rhythm. Drops titles and speaks plainly.
voice_direction.family_creditor: Warm, avuncular rhythm. Uses folksy idioms to disguise threats.
